title: browser.run input
description: Run one autonomous vision-based browser session for a single goal.

goal.description: Complete, self-contained instruction for the browser agent (what to do on the web, and what to bring back).

initial_url.description: Optional URL to open before planning. Omit to let the agent navigate itself.

max_steps.description: Upper bound on agent steps for this run.

max_step_extensions.description: How many times the run may ask to continue after reaching max_steps. Each request is only granted if the run has made verified progress recently. 0 disables extensions (hard stop at max_steps).

memory_mode.description: Browser workflow memory mode. auto = recall previous site workflows then index this run; learn = index only; recall = replay only; off = no memory.

headless.description: Run Chromium headless (default true on the VM).

credential_ref.description: Vault credential ref (vault:<entry_id>) from vault_lookup for the site that needs login. Resolved securely at dispatch; the model never sees the secret.
